import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', title_fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
df_age = df[df['age'].notna()]
ax2.hist([df_age[df_age['survived']==0]['age'], df_age[df_age['survived']==1]['age']], 
         bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival['embarked'].notna()]
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['embarked'], embark_survival['mean'], 
               color=['#FFE66D', '#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={int(count)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove outliers for better visualization
sns.violinplot(data=df_fare, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', 
               split=True, ax=ax4, palette={0: '#FF6B6B', 1: '#95E1D3'})
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=11)
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family size vs survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean().reset_index()
ax5.plot(family_survival['family_size'], family_survival['survived'], 
         marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#4ECDC4')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 6. Overall survival rate pie chart
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Overall Survival Rate', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(11)

# 7. Survival by alone status and sex
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
alone_survival = df.groupby(['alone', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
alone_pivot = alone_survival.pivot(index='alone', columns='sex', values='survived')
alone_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.6)
ax7.set_title('Survival Rate: Traveling Alone vs With Family', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Traveling Alone', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax7.set_xticklabels(['With Family', 'Alone'], rotation=0)
ax7.legend(title='Sex', title_fontsize=10)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax7.set_ylim(0, 1)

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
